effect: Connects every issue criterion and accepted qualification to a complete multi-commit comparison and matching test evidence.

semantic.criterion: The PR describes CSV serialization and command routing, including the header and escaping behavior; it is consistent with the complete two-commit comparison rather than only its last commit.

The body accounts for AC1, AC2 and AC3 without weakening them, including UTF-8/no BOM, and connects each to the relevant behavior and named passing checks. It identifies the command or retained run and the proposed revision that the evidence covers.
It attributes results to the retained run, does not claim to have rerun tests, and does not use a generic all-tests-pass statement as the sole support for the ACs.
It uses a descriptive title without a commit prefix, the Change and Acceptance evidence headings, and usable issue/evidence destination links rather than machine-local scratch paths.
